player_0.content: New plan: I failed because I misinterpreted the ranking system. In these logic puzzles, "finished above" means a lower numerical rank (e.g., 1st is above 2nd), but I incorrectly assumed "above" meant a higher number or got confused by the relative constraints. Specifically, I saw "Mya finished second" and immediately selected option (B) without verifying if the other constraints (like "Mel finished below Joe" and "Mya finished above Rob") created a contradiction that would force a different interpretation or if I missed a subtle clue about the total count. Next time, I will first explicitly define the ranking scale (1 = First, 7 = Last), then map every relative constraint (above/below) to specific numerical inequalities before checking the options. I will only select an answer if it is the only one consistent with all derived inequalities, rather than stopping at the first explicit fact.
